STRAT 392 Market Entry Strategy Assignment (60 pts, due Tue Nov 17 11:59pm MT) needs your team.

What is due: one team video, 3 to 5 minutes, on one physical product with a real six-digit HS code. Each member needs an iLabz.org account and the weighted lab results must be on screen. One submission per team.

What I need from you: your actual STRAT team and confirmation that each member has an iLabz account. The old Raising Cane's restaurant deck does not qualify because a restaurant is a service with no HS code.

Reply with your team members and I will run the lab and build the video. The later online reading quizzes do not need you.
